FIRE INCIDENT - DONOVAN ST
(November 15th, 2026)
~ 9:10 p.m; An SJRFD Captain confirmed to NFLD Bulletin at the scene that the incident was caused by dryer lint. There was no fire, smoke or damage reported, and no injuries
~ 9:00 p.m; Emergency crews are on scene of a reported fire incident on Donovan Street in Mount Pearl.
The incident appears to be minor in nature, with the majority of fire fighters having since cleared the scene.
SJRFD and RNC remain on scene. More information will be posted as it becomes available.
